description: Defines an internal interface IActivationLifetime for managing activation lifecycle, including deactivation cancellation and blocking.

classes.name: IActivationLifetime
classes.description: Interface for managing activation lifecycle, providing a token for deactivation and a method to block deactivation.

methods.name: BlockDeactivation
methods.description: Initiates a block to prevent deactivation; returns an IDisposable to lift the block.
